defects.title: Unused import useMemo
defects.cwe_or_cite: ESLint @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars; TS6133
defects.rationale: X-SEV-08 (h): unused import, no runtime effect, autofixable: nit.

defects.title: Live third-party API secret embedded in client-side code ships to every browser; proxy through the backend
defects.cwe_or_cite: CWE-798; CWE-200; OWASP A07:2021
defects.rationale: X-SEV-04 (d): live third-party secret in client code ships to every visitor's browser (CWE-200 on top of CWE-798): blocker.

defects.title: No res.ok check and no try/catch around load(): a failed request rejects unhandled, loading stays true forever and the user sees an endless spinner
defects.cwe_or_cite: WHATWG Fetch Standard (fetch resolves on HTTP errors); typescript-eslint no-floating-promises
defects.rationale: Rubric C2 x R1: unhandled failure at an I/O boundary on the component's main view; any network error or non-OK response leaves the spinner forever. No data loss: major.

defects.title: N+1 sequential request waterfall: one awaited author fetch per review inside a loop
defects.cwe_or_cite: CWE-1073; web.dev 'Avoid request chains'
defects.rationale: X-SEV-02 (b): one sequential remote call per review on every page view; the client requests no page size, so the count grows with the product's reviews: major.

defects.title: Leftover console.log dumps review and author data to the browser console
defects.cwe_or_cite: ESLint no-console
defects.rationale: X-SEV-07 (g): console.log runs on every page load (the frontend equivalent of a request path); it logs public display data, not secrets or PII: minor.

defects.title: useEffect dependency array omits productId: reviews are never refetched when the product changes (stale data for the new product)
defects.cwe_or_cite: React docs: useEffect 'Specifying reactive dependencies'; eslint-plugin-react-hooks exhaustive-deps
defects.rationale: Rubric C2 x R1: likely bug; after client-side navigation to another product the previous product's reviews stay on screen. Wrong data shown, nothing corrupted: major.

defects.title: Stored XSS: user-written review body (and third-party translation) rendered as raw HTML
defects.cwe_or_cite: CWE-79; OWASP A03:2021; React docs dangerouslySetInnerHTML
defects.rationale: X-SEV-04 (d): stored XSS; any user's review body runs as HTML in every visitor's browser: blocker.

defects.title: Clickable div is not focusable or keyboard-operable and has no role; use a <button type="button">
defects.cwe_or_cite: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard; jsx-a11y click-events-have-key-events, no-static-element-interactions
defects.rationale: X-SEV-06 (f): 'Translate' is one secondary control; keyboard users lose translation but can still read reviews and use the page: minor.

defects.title: Translation cache is keyed by review id only, so after the target language changes the old translation is still shown
defects.trigger: A user translates a review to French, then changes targetLanguage to German: the translated map already holds an entry for that review id, so the French text is shown as the German translation until the page reloads.
defects.cwe_or_cite: TanStack Query docs 'Query Keys' (every variable the result depends on belongs in the key); the same rule applies to a hand-rolled cache
defects.rationale: C2 (wrong result under a specific condition: a language change after a translation) x R1 (any visitor of a product page): major.

defects.title: deleteTask server action deletes any task by id with no session or project-membership check (updateTaskStatus does check), so anyone can delete any project's tasks
defects.evidence: const { projectId } = await db.task.delete({ where: { id }, select: { projectId: true } });
defects.trigger: Any visitor, signed in or not, POSTs the deleteTask server action (the action id ships in the client bundle; server actions are public POST endpoints) with another project's task UUID; the task is deleted.
defects.cwe_or_cite: CWE-862 Missing Authorization; CWE-639; OWASP A01:2021; Next.js docs 'Data Security: Server Actions' (verify authorization inside every action)
defects.rationale: C1 (attacker destroys other tenants' data) x R1 (public endpoint, any caller); X-SEV-04 auth bypass is never downgraded: blocker.

defects.title: Module-level QueryClient used in a server component: its cache is shared by every request, and dehydrate(serverQueryClient) sends every project's cached tasks to whoever renders next
defects.evidence: const serverQueryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 60_000 } } });
defects.trigger: User A (member of project P1) loads /projects/P1; then user B (member of P2 only) loads /projects/P2 on the same server instance: the dehydrated state embedded in B's HTML contains the ['tasks', P1] query with P1's tasks. Within 60 s staleTime prefetchQuery also serves cached data instead of reloading.
defects.cwe_or_cite: CWE-488 Exposure of Data Element to Wrong Session; CWE-668; TanStack Query docs 'Server Rendering & Hydration' (create the QueryClient per request, never at file root)
defects.rationale: U2 shared state across requests and users makes it C1; the leaked data is other tenants' tasks, reachable by any signed-in member of any project (R1): blocker.

defects.title: Stale closure: the interval is created once ([] deps) and keeps formatting the updatedAt captured at mount, so the 'Updated X ago' label never reflects a newer timestamp
defects.trigger: A card stays mounted while its task's updatedAt changes (the board refetches after a teammate edits the task); the label keeps showing the age of the old timestamp, e.g. 'Updated 3 hours ago' for a task edited a minute ago, until the card remounts.
defects.cwe_or_cite: React docs 'useEffect: Removing unnecessary dependencies / stale closures'; eslint-plugin-react-hooks exhaustive-deps; Dan Abramov 'Making setInterval Declarative with React Hooks'
defects.rationale: C3 (a secondary informational label shows an outdated age; nothing acts on it) x R1 (any board after an edit): minor.

defects.title: Search effect fetches on every keystroke with no AbortController or ignore flag, so a slow earlier response overwrites the results for the newer term
defects.trigger: Type 'dep' then 'deploy' quickly; the 'dep' request resolves after the 'deploy' request and setResults shows 'dep' matches under the 'deploy' query. Clearing the box while a request is in flight also lets the late response refill the list.
defects.cwe_or_cite: React docs 'You Might Not Need an Effect: Fetching data' (race condition, cleanup with ignore flag); CWE-362
defects.rationale: C2 (wrong result under specific timing) x R1 (any user typing a search on a normal network): major.

defects.title: Numeric && in JSX: when a column has no tasks, React renders a stray '0' in that column
defects.trigger: Any column with zero tasks (for example 'Done' on a new project) renders the text '0' under its heading.
defects.cwe_or_cite: React docs 'Conditional Rendering' pitfall: don't put numbers on the left side of &&
defects.rationale: C3 (visible UI glitch, no data effect) x R1 (every empty column): minor.

defects.title: Array index used as key for TaskCards that hold local state (the armed delete confirmation) in lists that shrink and reorder, so state moves to a different task
defects.trigger: Column 'To do' has [A, B, C]. Click Delete on B (its card shows 'Confirm delete'), then move A to Done: the list becomes [B, C], the stateful card at index 1 now renders C with confirmingDelete still true, and clicking 'Confirm delete' deletes C, which the user never chose.
defects.cwe_or_cite: React docs 'Rendering Lists: Why does React need keys?' (index keys and state); eslint-plugin-react no-array-index-key
defects.rationale: C2 (component state attached to the wrong task, can lead to deleting the wrong task after a further click) x R1 (any reorder or delete on the board): major.

defects.title: Optimistic status update writes the cache in onMutate but keeps no snapshot and has no onError rollback (and no onSettled refetch), so a rejected move stays on screen
defects.trigger: updateTaskStatus throws (the user was removed from the project, or the network drops): the alert says the change was not saved but the card stays in the new column, because onSuccess is the only path that refetches; the board contradicts the server until some later refetch.
defects.cwe_or_cite: TanStack Query docs 'Optimistic Updates' (snapshot in onMutate, roll back in onError, invalidate in onSettled)
defects.rationale: C2 (unhandled failure at an I/O boundary leaves wrong state displayed) x R1 (any failed move): major. Not a persistent write itself, so U1 does not apply.

defects.title: Unused import useCallback
defects.trigger: Run the linter or tsc with noUnusedLocals: useCallback is imported and never used.
defects.cwe_or_cite: ESLint @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars; TS6133
defects.rationale: C4 (unused name, no runtime effect, autofixable; D4) at any reachability: nit.

decoys.evidence: const row: TaskRow = await db.task.update({ where: { id }, data: { status: nextStatus } });
decoys.why_fine: Updates by id alone, but the previous line runs requireProjectMember on the task's own projectId, so ownership is checked (contrast with deleteTask).
Module-level object, but an immutable, stateless formatter holding no per-user or per-request data; sharing it is safe (contrast with the module-level QueryClient).
Index keys on static, stateless loading placeholders derived from a constant list that is never reordered.

decoys.why_fine: User input goes into the URL through URLSearchParams, which encodes it; projectId is passed through encodeURIComponent on the next line.

defects.title: Committed it.only: every other test in the file is skipped
defects.evidence: it.only('renders one column per status', async () => {
defects.trigger: Run vitest locally or in watch mode: only this test runs and the other four are silently skipped; in CI, Vitest's default allowOnly=false turns it into a failed run.
defects.cwe_or_cite: Vitest docs: test.only and the allowOnly option; eslint-plugin-vitest no-focused-tests
defects.rationale: C3 (contained: skipped tests locally, a red CI run that is noticed) x R1 (every run of this file): minor. Rated on its effect on the test run; D3 is not applied because the defect is in the test's own job, not production code copied into a test.

defects.title: userEvent.type is not awaited, so the assertion runs before any keystroke and the test passes without exercising search
defects.trigger: The test body continues synchronously: queryByRole('alert') is checked before typing starts and before any search request; a regression that makes search fail (alert shown after the response) still passes, and the pending typing leaks into the next test with act() warnings.
defects.cwe_or_cite: Testing Library user-event v14 docs (all APIs return promises and must be awaited); eslint-plugin-testing-library await-async-events
defects.rationale: C2 (search error handling is effectively untested: a test that cannot fail) x R1 (deterministic on every run): major. D3 not applied: the defect is the test's own correctness.

defects.title: Test selects by CSS class through container.querySelectorAll, asserting an implementation detail instead of what the user sees
defects.trigger: Renaming the task-card class (or rendering cards with a different element) fails the test with no behaviour change; a card rendered with the class but without its content still passes.
defects.cwe_or_cite: Testing Library docs 'Guiding principles' and 'Which query should I use?' (container.querySelector is the last resort); eslint-plugin-testing-library no-container, no-node-access
defects.rationale: C3 (brittle test: maintenance cost, weaker signal) x R1 (every run): minor.

defects.title: The only assertion checks that a vi.fn mock exists, which is always true, so the move test asserts nothing about the move
defects.trigger: In this setup the move actually fails (db.task.findUniqueOrThrow is a bare vi.fn returning undefined, so destructuring projectId throws inside updateTaskStatus) and the test still passes; it would also pass if the select did nothing at all.
defects.cwe_or_cite: Kent C. Dodds 'Common mistakes with React Testing Library'; Vitest expect docs (toHaveBeenCalledWith); xUnit Test Patterns 'Assertion Roulette / tests without assertions'
defects.rationale: C2 (the move flow, the board's main write, is untested while appearing covered) x R1 (deterministic on every run): major.

defects.title: Membership lookup is mocked to always return a member, so no test proves that a non-member is rejected
defects.trigger: requireProjectMember is removed or inverted in the page or the actions: every test still passes because the mocked lookup grants access to everyone.
defects.cwe_or_cite: OWASP ASVS V4 (access control: deny by default, verify with negative tests); Vitest docs 'vi.mock'
defects.rationale: C2 (new authorization logic without a negative test: false confidence) x R1 (every project route depends on it); tests.md default for the only test of auth logic is major.

decoys.why_fine: waitFor contains only an assertion, no side effects, and is awaited.
A hardcoded fixture UUID, not a credential or secret.
Synchronous getBy* without await is correct here: the preceding awaited findByRole guarantees the board has rendered.
Interval effect with [] deps, but the callback reads no props or state (only Date.now()); updatedAt is read during render, so nothing goes stale.
Money is stored and transported as integer minor units; the division is only for display, uses the currency's ISO 4217 minor digits, and is rounded back to those digits by the formatter.
A float used for a display ratio, not money; division by zero is guarded.
String comparison of zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD dates is chronological; the && chain is boolean on the left so nothing stray renders.
Date-only value parsed as UTC midnight and formatted with timeZone 'UTC', so it never shifts to the previous day in negative-offset zones.

Search results come from a query keyed by the (debounced) filters and pass the abort signal; TanStack Query shows data for the current key only, so out-of-order responses cannot overwrite newer results.
